subject: Archive savings ownership proposal
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: Archive savings ownership proposal

Irene / Marissa,

Quick note following the retention deep-dive last week: our projected log egress and retention add-on spend for Cardinal Media is trending +48% year-over-year if we keep the current 90-day default in Datadog and Grafana Cloud. The primary drivers are spike-heavy ingestion from batch analytics and a small subset of services that keep verbose debug logs.

I sketched a lightweight ownership model (attached) that splits the archive surcharge between platform (50%), product analytics (30%), and ML research (20%) for the first 6-month pilot. The idea is to:
- Create owned SLAs for the noisy services and gate high-ingest pipelines behind explicit approvals
- Apply a per-service retention tier (7/30/90) and measure error surface for 30-day to 90-day regressions
- Negotiate temporary credits with Datadog and Grafana while we run the pilot

Can you review and say whether procurement/legal should engage vendors now or after we finalize the allocation table? Also curious if we should involve SRE on the enforcement side or keep it with platform.

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Archive savings ownership proposal

Ben — thanks for the draft. I read your spreadsheet and added a couple of scenarios (see ownership-model-v1.xlsx). Key recommendations from my side:

1) Pilot scope: 6 weeks, cover the three highest-ingest services (ingest-api, analytics-batch, model-trainer).
2) Cost split: Platform 40%, Product Analytics 35%, Research 25% for pilot. We should be slightly more conservative on platform to keep runway for enforcement work.
3) Vendor asks: request 60 days of Datadog credits tied to ingestion spikes, and a Grafana Cloud ingestion-waiver for compressed logs. I'll draft the vendor email if you want.
4) Compliance/legal: require that retention-tier changes are captured in a revision to the data-retention policy; procure should push a short addendum for Datadog/Grafana SOW amendments.

I also recommend a two-track approach:
- Negotiation track: Procurement/Legal negotiate credits and addenda with vendors (Datadog/Grafana/Sentry).
- Engineering track: Platform and SRE implement retention gates + tagging for noisy sources so we can measure before/after.

If everyone agrees, I'll loop in procurement this afternoon and copy the vendor contacts you mentioned at the summit. Attaching a heatmap of expected monthly delta if we shift to 30 days for analytics (cost-heatmap.png).

Irene

--
Irene Choi
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0121

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sam Wong <sam.wong@datadoghq.com>, partners@grafana.com
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Archive savings ownership proposal

Thanks — I like the two-track approach. From procurement's POV:
- We should ask Datadog for a usage-credit tied specifically to ingestion bursts from analytics-batch (callout in doc).
- Grafana can be asked for a temporary compressed-ingest rate for 90->30 day migration while we measure error rates.
- Ask Sentry for a scoped retention exception for crash logs (separate Sentry project) so we don't pay full index costs for low-signal events.

Next steps: Irene, can you send the vendor-facing draft? Ben, can you pull the last 6 months of ingestion delta for the three services and drop into the Drive folder? Procurement will prepare an addendum template after we see vendor response.

-Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Head of GTM Ops (Procurement liaison)
Redwood Inference

From: Sam Wong <sam.wong@datadoghq.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: alex.sentry@observability.io, partners@grafana.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Archive savings ownership proposal

Thanks for the context — Sam from Datadog here. Happy to run a short pilot tied to ingestion spikes. Proposed next steps from our side:
- Provide a 45-day credit to offset ingestion bursts for the three named services (requires billing team sign-off).
- Share a compact ingestion report template so you can show before/after delta (I can put that into the Drive folder).
- If you can send the RACI and the specific service tags we should monitor, we'll bind the credit to those tags.

I'll coordinate with Grafana and Sentry on a combined response and loop back by EOD Wednesday.

Best,
Sam
Datadog — Strategic Accounts
